title: Installing Anvi'o using a Docker Image
author: James E Thornton Jr
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kfjctkn

steps.title: Install Docker Toolbox or OS X Installer
steps.instruction: Download and install Docker Toolbox 1.12.2 for Windows or the OS X installer for Anvi’o on macOS, keeping all default options.

substeps.instruction: Download DockerToolbox-1.12.2.exe for Windows from the Docker Toolbox page (scroll to downloads).
Install using default settings (do not uncheck any options).
For macOS, download and run the OS X installer for Anvi’o from https://www.docker.com/products/docker-toolbox.

steps.title: Launch Docker Quickstart Terminal
steps.instruction: Start Docker Quickstart Terminal and approve all permission prompts.

substeps.instruction: Start Docker Quickstart Terminal (Windows shortcut on desktop).
When prompted, click Yes to allow Docker initializations (may appear multiple times).

steps.title: Record Green IP Address
steps.instruction: After Docker finishes initializing, note the green IP address shown in the terminal for later use.

substeps.instruction: After initialization, note the green IP address displayed in the terminal.
Record this IP address for later use.

steps.title: Run Anvi'o Docker Image
steps.instruction: Pull and start the Anvi’o Docker container, mapping host port 8080 to container port 8080.

substeps.instruction: Run: docker run -p 8080:8080 -it meren/anvio:latest in the terminal.

steps.title: Wait for Container Prompt
steps.instruction: Allow the container to finish loading until the prompt matches the example, indicating the environment is ready.

substeps.instruction: Wait until the container shows the ready prompt (as illustrated).

steps.title: Execute Anvi'o Self-Test
steps.instruction: Run the built‑in self‑test to verify the installation.

substeps.instruction: Execute: anvi-self-test at the container prompt.

steps.title: Open Chrome and Access Anvi'o
steps.instruction: Use Google Chrome to open the Anvi’o web interface at the recorded IP address on port 8080.

substeps.instruction: Open Google Chrome (install from https://www.google.com/chrome/browser/desktop/index.html if needed).
Enter the recorded IP address followed by :8080 (e.g., 192.168.99.100:8080) in the address bar.

steps.title: Terminate Session and Verify Visualization
steps.instruction: Confirm the example visualization appears, then stop the interactive session with Ctrl + C.

substeps.instruction: Confirm an example Anvi’o visualization appears.
Return to the terminal and press Ctrl + C to terminate the anvi‑interactive session.

steps.title: Finalize Installation
steps.instruction: Anvi’o is now ready for use with your own data; consult the guidelines for binding data directories.
